what: The planned Kite depth-extension backfill, its coverage verification, the re-seeded native history, and the classification of every absence the extended census reports.

coverage_verification.duplicates_structurally_impossible: PRIMARY KEY (symbol, ts) on intraday_bars; the count is reported rather than assumed

native_history_reseed.arrival_discipline: INSERT OR IGNORE on PRIMARY KEY (symbol, end): the 4,150,272 pre-existing rows keep their original 2026-10-22 receipt and only the 1,593,993 new rows carry today's. No arrival time was backdated.

session_schedule.why_not: The schedule declares dated exceptions only, and NativeSessionSchedule.load constrains them to 2026-08-03 <= day < 2026-12-07. The four dated special pre-open notices are 2025-01-06, 2025-10-14, 2025-12-05 and 2026-04-30. The backfilled range 2023-09-01..2024-08-01 precedes every one of them, so the normal session applies and there is nothing dated to add.

session_tail_14616.cause: NSE Closing Auction Session, effective 2026-08-03 by SEBI circular. Continuous trading ends 15:15 and the close is set by auction, so the 15:20/15:25/15:30 candles DO NOT EXIST for a CAS member.

special_preopen_14.cause: Four dated exchange special pre-open notices: ITC 2025-01-06, TMPV 2025-10-14, HINDUNILVR 2025-12-05, VEDL 2026-04-30. Continuous trading started late that day.

gvtd_zero_trade_12.cause: Twelve isolated single-interval absences, all in GVT&D, on eleven scattered dates between 2023-10-09 and 2024-04-23. GVT&D is the 3rd least liquid of the 95 members over the backfilled range by median five-minute volume (383). It holds 16,842 bars against 16,854 for a fully covered member -- exactly 12 fewer. Neighbouring intervals carry volumes of 0 to 60.
gvtd_zero_trade_12.verified_upstream: The broker was re-asked for four of these sessions. Kite's own response returns 74 candles, not 75, and the absent interval is missing from the broker's response too: 2023-10-09 13:55, 2023-10-10 13:20, 2023-12-05 11:05 and 2024-01-25 09:15 are all ABSENT upstream while both neighbours on each side are present. The backfill did not miss them; no such candle exists.
gvtd_zero_trade_12.not_a_request_window_artefact: Single intervals, not a contiguous block, not aligned to any session boundary, and shared with no other member.

execution.status: started, then stopped before any fit completed
execution.measured_cost: SUPERSEDED. This originally read that 35 minutes and 501 CPU-seconds producing zero fits implied hours per fit. Per-candidate timing on the dated path gives a mean fit_pending of 43.3s and about 5.1 hours for the whole 423-candidate run. Cost was never the blocker; point-in-time basket coverage is. See replay-blocker-epoch-coverage.json in this directory.
execution.why_stopped: A concurrent session needed prototype_runs/live.sqlite quiet for an authoritative full suite. The run is resumable: --max-fits bounds a run and it resumes where it stopped.

readiness_arithmetic_unchanged.conclusion: At the declared five-session cadence the 252-observation requirement stays unsatisfiable no matter how much history is acquired. The depth extension did clear the 751-session bar that cadence 1 would need, which is a real change, but refit_sessions is part of _compatible and changing it invalidates existing fits. It remains an owner decision and was NOT changed. The 252 threshold was not changed either.
readiness_arithmetic_unchanged.also_see: replay-blocker-epoch-coverage.json: 70 epoch-basket members had no intraday bars at all, which is why no historical fit could be produced regardless of cadence.
